title: Seven Winters and One Short Letter
subtitle: 科学研究 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学研究（人与社会·科学与技术）
meta: 主题语境：科学研究（人与社会·科学与技术）　|　核心词汇：expert　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 expert 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 my aunt ① consulted an expert that no officer in the town would have trusted, and she said the consulting was the whole of the winter. The ② expert, meaning the man himself and not the report, ran seven winters and stayed untrusted in the book; an expert, she said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left untrusted.

Every ③ expert in that town had the same short letter beside him, and the ④ expert at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the bridge and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An expert, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to trust; my aunt said the trusting is the part that fills seven winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the expert was the whole of the matter, meaning the skill and not the man. The ⑥ expert, meaning the skill and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody trusts; expert, he said, is either somebody you consult or the only word that means both a man and skill. He said the skill is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ expert had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short letter. The ⑧ expert of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in January, was one town and seven winters of trusting; expert, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to trust. She said the trusting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ expert I remember is the one trusted in the register, which closed in 1988 and is still described as the quietest in the town. An ⑩ expert, my mother said in 1990, is the only one that improves by being trusted; every expert, she said, is skill that has agreed to look like a man. She said the skill was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 专家；行家（指镇上每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 专家（指那个人本身，与报告相对）
C. 固定搭配：consult an expert 咨询一位专家
D. n. 专家（指留给大桥的那一位）
E. n. 专家（抽象总称，指一座镇上的专家之事）
F. n. 专家（指名册上写到、被登记的那一位）
G. n. 专长；专门技艺（指一件事里人人都等却无人信赖的那样东西）
H. n. 专长（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人信赖的那样东西）

items.q: consulted an expert that no officer in the town would have trusted
The expert, meaning the man himself and not the report
the expert at the far side
the expert was the whole of the matter
the expert had become a line in a register
The expert of the whole thing
An expert, my mother said in 1990

answers.why: consult an expert 意为“咨询一位专家”，1979 年姑姑咨询了一位镇上没有一位官员肯信赖的专家。
expert 意为“专家”，指那个人本身而不是报告，他经过了七个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
expert 意为“专家”，指镇上每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一封短短的信。
expert 意为“专家”，指留给大桥的那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
expert 意为“专长、专门技艺”，指一件事里人人都等却无人信赖的那样东西，叔叔说这份专长就是那件事的全部。
expert 意为“专长”，指人人都等却无人信赖的那样东西而不是那一位专家，是事情里人人都等、却无人信赖的东西。
expert 意为“专家”，指名册上写到、被登记的那一位，到 1985 年这一位成了名册里的一行。
expert 意为“专家”，姑姑一月写道，整件事的专家之事是一座镇子和七个冬天的信赖。
expert 意为“专家”，我记得的是名册上登记的那一位，1988 年结束了，至今仍被说成镇上最安静的一位。
expert 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，一位专家是唯一会因为被好好信赖而变得更好的东西。
